excerpts.text: Terms & Conditions –FAB Islamic Salary Transfer Campaign 2026
Eligible customers will earn 1.67% cashback on their monthly salary credit when they transfer
their salary to FAB Islamic and spend 20% of their monthly salary. The cashback is capped at
a maximum of AED 750 per month, with a maximum total cashback of AED 9,000 over 12
months. The total cashback over 12 months equals to 20% of a month’s salary, if customer
qualifies every month.
• Start Date: 01/09/2026
• Both dates are inclusive.
1. This campaign is open to new FAB Islamic customers or existing FAB customers with no
salary transfer to FAB in the preceding 12 months and a minimum monthly salary of AED
2. The Customer must receive their first salary into an eligible FAB Islamic account during the
campaign period.
3. Eligible accounts: Amana Islamic Account. The salary must be credited directly into this
account.
5. The customer must obtain a new FAB Islamic credit card during the campaign period to be
eligible for the cashback
1. Private Banking customers, SME customers, and FAB Staff account holders.
2. Customers with delinquent accounts or overdue payments on any FAB product.
1. Salary credits into non-AED currency accounts.
2. Salary credits into any account other than the eligible Amana Islamic account specified
in Section 3 (Islamic Savings account is not eligible).
3. Transactions made using conventional (non-Islamic) credit cards.
4. Salary credits not identifiable by transaction code.
5. Reversed or disputed transactions.
Qualifying Criteria — Save or Spend
1. To earn cashback each month, the Customer must meet the following condition:
o Spend: Spend at least 20% of their monthly salary using a new FAB Islamic Credit
Card opened during the campaign period.
2. Only successful, non-reversed card transactions qualify. Cash advances, balance transfers,
and annual or joining card fees on the credit card do not count as eligible spend.
3. Where more than one salary credit is received in a calendar month, all credits shall be
aggregated to form the basis for the 20% threshold. Multiple salary credits do not entitle the
Customer to additional cashback beyond the monthly cap.
4. The 20% threshold is recalculated each month based on actual salary credited; any change
in salary automatically adjusts the qualifying target.
2. The Customer may earn cashback for up to 12 consecutive months from the month of the
first qualifying salary credit, provided the Spend criteria are met each month.
3. Cashback is credited monthly directly to your eligible FAB Islamic account as AED
cashback, within 45 calendar days following the end of the month in which the salary
deposit is credited to the account. Subject to a valid salary of AED 5,000 or above being
received and at least one qualifying condition being met.
4. If no qualifying salary is received in a given month, no cashback is awarded for that
month. Cashback resumes automatically when salary is next received, but missed
months are not credited retrospectively.
5. Cashback is capped at AED 750 per month and AED 9,000 over 12 months. Cashback
amounts are rounded down to the nearest full AED. No fils will be paid out.
7. If the customer closes their account before fulfilment, no cashback will be payable.
Offer Mechanics: Earn 1.67% Cashback on your credited Salary (20% Over 12 Months)
